senses.gloss: ch. (corresp. to h. מָשַׁךְ, נָטָה a. אָרַךְ) to stretch; to draw, pull, spread.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:30">Targ. Jud. XVI, 30</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 21:3">Targ. Deut. XXI, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 43:10">Targ. Jer. XLIII, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 55:4">Targ. Ps. LV, 4</cite> <he>יִיגְּדוּן</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <he>יגרון</he>; h. text <he>ימיטו</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 17:20">Targ. Y. Deut. XVII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:21">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 21</cite> <he>נגודו ידיכון וכ׳</he> withdraw your hands from (v. <cite ref="M02892"><he>מָשַׁךְ</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sukkah 4b:7">Succ. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוּד אסיק וכ׳</he> stretch and raise the partitions, i.e. adopt the legal fiction that the partitions around the stand are prolonged so as to reach the ceiling (v. <cite ref="D00313"><he>דּוֹפָן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 101a:3">Sabb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>גוּד אחית וכ׳</he> stretch and bring the partitions down, i.e. adopt the fiction that the walls are prolonged so as to reach the bottom.
<cite ref="Eruvin 4b:17">Erub. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>לְגוּד</he>, v. <cite ref="L00050"><he>לָבוּד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 68b:4">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>נְגִידוּ מיניה מיכליה</he> (Rashi: <he>נְגוּדוּ</he>) withdraw his food from him, reduce his rations.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a:11">B. Mets. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>למידש ולמִנְגַּד</he> to tread the grapes and to conduct the wine into the pit.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:1">Ib. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>נַגְדוּ מתותיה וכ׳</he> they drew from under him sixty &c., v. <cite ref="M02882"><he>מְשִׂיכְלָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 111b:1">B. Bath. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>גוד לית וכ׳</he> draw (take me away from here), this man does not want to learn. Pesik. B’shall., p. 90ᵃ; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite> <he>גוד חמי לי</he> lead the way, show it to me.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:3">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>נגדו ליה גלימא</he> they spread for him (held up between him and the people) a cloak.
<cite ref="Eruvin 94a:2">Erub. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>שקולו … נְגִידוּ בה</he> take a cloak and spread it (as a partition); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:13">Ab. I, 13</cite> <he>נְגַד שמא וכ׳</he> he who stretches his fame (is ambitious), will lose his name.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:1">Targ. Ruth I, 1</cite> (h. text <he>שפט</he>).

senses.gloss: to grow long; to be drawn, follow after; to flow.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:33">Targ. Job XXI, 33</cite> (h. text <he>ימשוך</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 6:4">Targ. Jer. VI, 4</cite> (h. tex <he>ינטו</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:4">Targ. Cant. I, 4</cite> <he>נְגִדְנָא וכ׳</he> we are drawn after &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:13">Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:22">22</cite>; a. fr. (v. <cite ref="N00185"><he>נְגַר</he></cite>).—

B. Bath. 91ᵇ והוה נָגֵיד חוטא וכ׳ a line of honey flowed over both his arms; Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ bot. ונ׳ מלא וכ׳ and honey flowed as much as my hands could hold; a. e.—Part. pass. נְגִיד stretched, fainting (v. Ithpe.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 88:16">Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 16</cite>.—
Sabb. 152ᵃ, v. Ithpe.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:5">Targ. Cant. VII, 5</cite> <he>למִינְגַּד … לנַגָּדָא</he>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 33b:5">Keth. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>נַגְּדוּהָ</he>, v. <cite ref="A01918"><he>אִלְמָלֵא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:6">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>נַגְּדֵיה כרב</he> punish him in accordance with Rab’s practice.
<cite ref="Pesachim 52a:2">Pes. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ולִינַגְּדֵיה מר נַגּוּדֵי</he> Ms. (ed. <he>נגידי</he>, corr. acc.) why do you not order him to be lashed?; a. e.

senses.gloss: to declare liable to lashes. Kidd. l. c.; Yeb. 52ᵃ, a. e. רב מַנְגִּיד (על) וכ׳ Rab decreed punishment for him who &c. Kidd. l. c. לא מינגיד רב (read: מנגיד, as) Yeb. l. c.
to be drawn, to extend; to run.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 34:11">Targ. Is. XXXIV, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:8">Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 8</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 45:19">Targ. Y. Gen. XLV, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:3">Targ. Is. XLIV, 3</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 27:10">Targ. I Sam. XXVII, 10</cite> (h. text <he>פשט</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 4:18">Targ. Josh. IV, 18</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: [to stretch one’s self,] to faint, fall away, die (h. גָּוַע).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:8">Targ. Gen. XXV, 8</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 50a">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>חלש וא׳ כי וכ׳</he> was sick and fainted (seemed to be dead), and when he came to &c.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 10b">B. Bath. 10ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:16">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ ואתנח</he> he became faint and sighed; <cite ref="Shabbat 152a:12">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>נגיד ואתנח</he>.

<cite ref="Makkot 11a">Macc. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 113b:3">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>מִינְּגִיד</he>, v. <cite ref="G00275"><he>זִיגּוֹד</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:7">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מינגיד</he>, v. supra.]
